description: The image presents three pie charts, each representing different categories of difficulty in knowledge crosswords: easy, medium, and hard. The easy category has four slices with the following approximate proportions: 40.6%, 45.9%, 10.1%, and 3.3%. The medium category also has four slices with proportions of 44.6%, 44.3%, 3.9%, and 7.2%. The hard category is divided into three slices with proportions of 36.2%, 36.8%, and 20.1%, and a smaller slice at 7.0%. Each chart includes a legend with color-coded categories: N-K+ (light green), N-K- (yellow), N-K- (orange), and N+K- (red). The charts do not have percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
